note: Delvehold boundary, merged from four records of 2026-08-26. Delvehold is the first proving consumer of Ghostlight's generic world-simulation API, not an integration organ; adversarial single-player Dungeon play remains a regression and context-discovery path. Ghostlight adds only generic capability: one seed admission path shared by produced and consumer seeds, generic externally owned subject authority that admits institution and population-scale subjects through one tagged projection, consumer-supplied effect schemas, and typed proposals and receipts. Delvehold retains quantitative economy authority (quantities, prices, recipes, capacity, inventories, orders, contracts, conservation); Ghostlight resource handles never impersonate them. A forced ontology may bypass world generation but never kernel validation. The greathold ID and every delvehold.* binding stay Delvehold-owned; no cell or kernel switches on a consumer name. The legacy implementation those records described (WorldSeed transaction, ExternalSubjectAuthority, loopback RUDP operations) was torn down; the live implementation is the pass-10 confined consumer ingress in docs/architecture/ghostlight-world-consumer-api.md.

Standing pre-rebuild decisions, merged from seven records dated 2026-05-02 to 2026-08-29; map.yaml hard_boundaries and mission own the binding text. (1) VoidBot appraisal: appraiser and relationship/perception training must support human-facing reads, grounded opinions, uncertainty, repair signals, and opinion updates over repeated contact, not only fictional scene mutation. (2) Generated environment images are concept and material reference only; multi-angle or branch-consistent replay needs a durable scene-set source with named cameras and staging slots. (3) Coordinator turns are a sandboxed promptable organ with exact visible input, raw output, and labeled interventions; the meta-coordinator never collapses them into omniscient chat steering. (4) Character cognition is modeled state: the machinery is maximally smart, characters reason and maneuver only to the level their modeled state supports, and narrator prose may explain tactics for the reader without granting that explanation to characters. (5) ghostlight.agent_state.v0 is the shared cross-runtime payload contract, carried unchanged inside typed CultNet envelopes. (6) Multiplayer extends the one-WorldKernel, many-actor authority model: humans control distinct canonical actors through the same commit path, with no party prompt or room-state authority. (7) A newspaper is a persistent political/editorial Persona owning audience, remembered beats, framing, selective pickup, throughlines, and rivals; grounding constrains factual assertion and provenance while preserving legible interpretation; only the economic layer supplies advertisers.

Sealing the replacement kernel, 2026-09-01, four records merged; git owns the commits (b53251f, d49b907, 12ee9f4, 66ed2ec). The first uncommitted world.rs foundation passed its focused tests and was deleted anyway: it exposed mutable WorldState and ID issuance, let translation-gap inference become canonical mutation, let empty batches advance revision, left controller commands without consumed opportunity, readiness, and affordance binding, and made batch self-digests unverifiable. The rule that came out of it: seal private WorldKernel, aggregate, and journal ownership first, then reintroduce a minimal reducer behind it; never publish mutable world types or an ID issuer for test or adapter convenience. The Persona interpretation contract is structurally total: source prose is immutable noncanonical evidence bound to typed receipts, only exact typed captures propose state, actual quoted dialogue is required for speech, malformed spans and step exhaustion become whole-source gaps, and infrastructure interruption returns the source pending. Legacy ingresses were deleted without a compatibility writer.

Deployment authority, merged from a four-record supersession chain, 2026-09-02 to 2026-09-03; map.yaml live_architecture.deployment_authority owns the full current rule. The read-only cutover audit found the old Idunn path structurally unfit: source, ref, and floor policy duplicated across compiled Rust, raw executable command records, a privileged shell dispatcher, and gamecult-ops target programs; root Git unable to inspect idunn-owned mirrors; world-v2 purity checks ignoring most legacy state; fixed-port activation stopping the incumbent before the candidate was green. Adopted: target-owned visible recipes with constrained launch declarations (raw unit and container templates rejected; the operator-selected workload driver lowers them), Idunn-configured refs, runner, and host bindings, Git and recipe materialization as the Idunn identity, Expected published by plan, service-signed Present, a process write lease before writable state, Odin-derived Ready, route membership only after Ready, and deployment separate from continuity. The owner is exactly DeploymentCommand, DeploymentTransaction, and AdmittedGeneration with nine persisted phases before effects (Odin 65cf2b2; contracts on CultLib 85f7024; provider sides Ghostlight 6a79cb0 and CodexConnector ede3c30). Live admission remains absent. The Nginx route receipt proves configuration plus nginx -T visibility only, so an independently persisted data-plane observation is required before fence clearance, drain, or cutover acceptance. Do not issue the old Connector or Ghostlight redeploy helpers.

Core-stack consolidation, merged from ten records, 2026-09-03 to 2026-09-04. CultLib is the canonical home for CultCache, CultNet, and CultMesh across every runtime because wire-parity conformance lives only there; Ghostlight consumes all three by pinned rev 85f7024 (d0510ac), a permanent ancestor of CultLib main, and its vendored fork charter is deleted. Resolution key for older records: CultNet e542225 and f4ab237 and Odin d527d72 and 65cf2b2 were never on their repos' main branches; their content is on CultLib 85f7024 and Odin branch codex/ygg-idunn-independent-bootstrap, ported forward rather than merged, so those SHAs are dated history and GameCult/cultnet-rs may be retired. A whole-file symbol comparison, not a diff of recent changes, found four real capabilities in the forks (reliable send expiry owned by the transport profile, snapshot and per-entry compare-exchange, a framed-length check before allocation), all ported with tests; every other fork under F:/Projects held reach rather than divergence, and each consumer pinning a different branch was the combinatorial reason separate repos failed. CultLib main landed by fast-forward at 8cb3b72, so every consumer pin (Ghostlight 85f7024, Epiphany and CodexConnector e171eca, Odin cbde940) resolves from a fresh clone; a squash would have orphaned all of them. Odin eedce4f consumes CultLib, its recipe no longer requires gitlinks, and gamecult-ops 8f7ae2a drops the phantom gitlinks Idunn would have refused; odin-daemon reads systemd file descriptors and compiles only on Linux. Non-Rust forks persist for distribution, not divergence: npm and pip cannot consume a package from a git subdirectory, so CultLib 8cb3b72 adds tag-triggered publishing (@gamecult/cultcache-ts, cultcache-py on PyPI, MIT confirmed by the operator). Ghostlight keeps vendor/cultcache-py on sys.path deliberately so the state tooling runs from a bare clone; replacing it means session bootstrap must install.

Why the whole-machine rebuild, merged from three records, 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-04. Run 108 inspection: 2,400 active leaves across five realms with strong authored crisis theater, but repeated fission substituted taxonomy for novelty (557 other-unknown records, 780 residual, inherited identical goals, eight distinct Actors named Mara Venn); counting active leaves measured nothing about world shape. Run 115 terminated at revision 2, regions 2/8, waves 0/1, after an SSE timeout and a dangling institution location exhausted four reconciliation steps; the qualification, verifier, reconciliation, timeout, and routing patch sequence through 8964a92 never established ownership, and the operator ordered one WorldKernel, one typed reducer, one CommandEnvelope/CultCache commit path. The root cause was vocabulary-shaped, not model-shaped: caller-supplied string SubjectRefs, two-phase entity admission, and a flat mutation list made a dangling reference a runtime discovery rather than an unrepresentable input, and depth lived in free strings, so the model tribunals (ElaboratorTitle, WorldComplexity qualification and verification) were compensators for an ontology with nowhere to hold depth. Adopted cut: reducer-issued typed ID namespaces, draft handles resolved inside one closed WorldPatch before any ID allocates, twelve decision-constraining components, and elaboration that answers a derived CausalBoundary instead of running waves and quotas. Counts, cover ratios, interest, and diversity are evaluation evidence, never admission or completeness authority. Run 115's root at /var/lib/gamecult/ghostlight-dungeon/acceptance/full-world-delvehold-0a83034-115 and invocation d9254cd9b77946aebcf7a7fdae821402 stay immutable; do not resume it.

Ontology v2 decisions and the scale directive, 2026-09-04, two records merged; docs/architecture/ghostlight-world-ontology.md owns the vocabulary. Elaboration and character action lower under one WorldPatch and one deterministic verifier. Affordances are world-authored data (preconditions, effect slots, weighted outcome bands) over a closed operation set, so genre lives in the seed and the kernel never learns one; uncertainty resolves by kernel entropy seeded from world, revision, and command, so no model ever chooses success; proposals bind to a scope digest of the components their verification reads rather than the whole state digest, so many subjects and elaborators do not serialize on one revision. Elaborator tools are a derived projection of the operation set and cannot drift. Operator correction, preserve in intent: the 2,400-subject / 240-cell / 10% cover profile is deliberate design, not a load fixture; a world feels alive only when actors at every level pursue their own goals, so that detail is generated first and multiresolution simulation is then choked so attention is scarce and selection is forced. The seed carries a WorldScaleIntent whose structurally counted deficit (an active subject with one controller, one Goal commitment, one affordance) the elaborators pursue after boundaries; a budgeted connected cover runs every tick with singleton detail cells and grouped coarse cells. Deleted for good: gestalt as canonical identity, arena knowledge union, semantic qualification and verification models, fission quotas as mutation, string identifiers.

Codex CLI fan-out cannot commit. A linked git worktree fails because its .git file points outside the sandbox's writable roots, and a full clone fails too: the Codex workspace-write sandbox keeps .git read-only even under the writable root, so a Codex worker can never commit or push regardless of clone layout or network grant. Rule for any Codex fan-out that must produce committed work: the worker writes files only; a supervisor outside the sandbox commits and pushes the clone after the worker exits. The elaborator scheduler (C:/Users/Meta/.claude/worlds) does this per slot to slot/<world>/<title>/<stamp> branches in the Ghostlight world clone and the lore clone; integration into codex/world-<world> and codex/ghostlight-worlds is a separate deliberate pass, still owed. Clones live at F:/Projects/Ghostlight-worlds/<world> and F:/Projects/<Lore>-worktrees/ghostlight-worlds (full clones despite the name).

Plan step 6, the ontology widening, is complete: ten passes landed on codex/ghostlight-dungeon-mvp, 2026-09-04 to 2026-09-05, each a Hands cut in an isolation worktree, a Soul falsification in the same tree, and a gated integration (pass tips are in git history and the handoff). The kernel holds twelve decision-constraining component kinds over a pinned operation catalog under one WorldPatch, one reducer, one CAS commit, one decode bound for both authoring lanes, and three confined SystemCapability arms (Clock, Elaborator, Consumer). Soul's series verdict: the eleven plan invariants hold structurally (one reducer and atomic commit; kernel-derived authority; one controller per scope with no fallback or double action; total interpretation with exact gaps; deterministic structural rejection without a model verifier; scoped knowledge until explicit communication; external-consumer sovereignty; sparse causal sufficiency with counts as evidence only; restart reconstructs the exact world; IDs allocated only inside an admitted reduction; opportunities bound to a scope digest rather than a revision); the pairing invariant is re-decided at three gates by doctrine, not by a repair loop. The budgeted cover verified 22 ticks at the 2,400/240 profile with fairness ceil(N/R), R being cells minus urgency slots. Two decisions stay with the operator and are recorded nowhere else durable: whether a refused coupled constituent may re-submit once inside the same tick, decided with the submitted-versus-committed number in hand; and the authority for an owner-only Eve world.run_tick command.

The rebuilt kernel runs on the road, 2026-09-05; runbook notes/local-live-smoke.md. Genesis smoke: tick driver, cover, Persona membrane, operational lane, clock, and elaboration sweep ran three ticks against a real CodexConnector; the road worked and the prose was thin because genesis is three subjects in one room, which made the seed producer an evidenced gap rather than an argued one. Seeded smoke: from the Kalsa Public vault one seed session authored six qualified persons into Low Sere in one round, deficit 6 to 0, and three ticks of eight singleton cells had the seeded people speaking to each other by name. Twelve runs were needed; every failure was on the road, not in the kernel, and each is now a rule in the tree: one credential family (the operator's real codex home), strict schemas (anyOf, typed tags, an offline totality test over both lanes), a Persona model the account supports, connector expiry skew below the response timeout, canonical ids printed beside labels, a seed round budget with parallel calls and budget-end submit, content-addressed provider request ids, the commitment shape rule in the tool description, and the placement rule. The harness fails on an empty seed or a silent world. The Codex subscription lapsed during this series and the runs consumed half the monthly free quota; no Codex road run is possible until it is renewed.

Claude SDK inference port, plan step 11, 2026-09-06, two records merged. Research: the Agent SDK's system prompt is fully replaceable, built-ins strippable, CLAUDE.md loading stoppable, and assistant tool_use blocks come back verbatim with usage; but there is no silent capture, no replayable input list, no request id, and each query is one subprocess. Rejected: a Messages-API backend (no API budget) and a backend inside CodexConnector (a deliberately isolated Codex fork; nothing goes into it). Landed: a second InferencePort over a Node sidecar, routed per lane by model prefix, execute-through: the sidecar computes no tool result and Rust answers every call through a per-lane ToolResultOracle that is the evaluator's own fold, so divergence is impossible by construction; both ports share one prepare_invocation. Lesson that changes how any future transport is judged: a transport-side validator is a second semantics. The SDK's Zod layer stripped unknown keys and refused missing fields before the handler ran, so a claude lane silently admitted what the connector refused; the fix is one validator on both transports, the Rust decoder, with the sidecar handing arguments through unvalidated. Residual liability: a wrong-typed property reaches Rust as absent. The receipt is the SDK message, a named stopgap; the exit is a Messages-API port when API budget exists, deleting the sidecar whole. Not yet run on the road: the operator must install the Claude Code CLI and log in first; Ghostlight never holds the credential.
